updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Extended to Safeguard Copilot Web Searches
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from conducting external web searches when sensitive data is detected in queries. This expansion closes a critical data leakage vector by ensuring sensitive information cannot be exposed through AI-powered search functionality.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard enables administrators to monitor device health across their fleet, identifying systems that are not ready to receive policy updates and ensuring endpoint DLP deployment readiness. This visibility helps admins maintain consistent policy enforcement and quickly remediate health issues before they impact compliance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scope Lifecycle State Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Administrators now gain explicit control over how Adaptive Scopes evaluate recipient and site owner lifecycle states, ensuring policy targeting remains aligned with organizational changes and user status. This enhancement reduces manual scope updates and improves compliance accuracy for dynamic environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Archive Support for SharePoint
updates.summary: Administrators can now include file archiving actions within SharePoint retention policies, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining discoverability and compliance. This capability extends data lifecycle management beyond retention and deletion, reducing storage costs without compromising governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Guided Diagnostics Experience
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics tool helps users understand why DLP policies triggered, showing which conditions evaluated true or false and the order of policy evaluation. For E5 customers, Copilot-powered insights provide tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection Auto-Labeling Scale Increase
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is increasing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, accelerating data classification at rest. This 5x increase helps organizations close labeling gaps and prepare larger data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment with greater confidence.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Copilot in Government Clouds
updates.summary: DLP protection for Microsoft 365 Copilot is expanding to government cloud environments, preventing Copilot from returning responses or using sensitive data for grounding when prompts contain classified information. This extends real-time data leakage controls to government and sovereign cloud users.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: Out-of-box reporting shows DLP alert metrics including MTTA, MTTD, and MTTR, plus top sensitive information types exposed, with ability to define custom SLAs for different severity levels. This operational visibility helps security teams track and improve their incident response performance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Rule-Based Alert Tagging and Auto-Resolution
updates.summary: Administrators can define rules to automatically resolve or tag DLP alerts based on business context, reducing triage queue noise and improving alert routing efficiency. For example, rules can auto-resolve low-severity alerts for trusted partner domains or tag alerts by department.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels for Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Sensitivity labels can now be applied to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same label configuration as Microsoft 365 groups and sites. This extends classification and governance controls to cloud security groups without requiring separate label configuration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API support for archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) provides users a unified archive view across potentially distributed storage as EWS Graph APIs deprecate by October 2026. This enables seamless access and management of archived email data through modern APIs.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables direct migration of PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using the Exchange Migration Service two-step pattern: analysis phase followed by execution. This provides a cloud-native migration path for organizations moving PST data without on-premises infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56163 Azure Kubernetes Service Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authentication in a critical AKS function allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Organizations running AKS clusters should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62825 Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Azure Key Vault allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, potentially compromising secret and key management. Immediate patching is critical as Key Vault controls access to sensitive credentials and encryption keys.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56191 Microsoft Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Exchange Online allows unauthorized attackers to tamper with data and configurations over the network. This vulnerability puts email security and compliance at risk; admins should apply patches promptly.

updates.title: CVE-2026-58275 Azure DNS Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authorization in Azure DNS allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges, potentially compromising DNS resolution and network routing. Organizations should patch to prevent DNS hijacking and unauthorized access to DNS records.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62835 Online Services Information Disclosure
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Online Services allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over the network. This vulnerability could expose confidential data; patching should be prioritized.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56160 Azure Red Hat OpenShift Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Azure Red Hat OpenShift allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations running ARO clusters should patch to prevent lateral privilege escalation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: The Insider Risk Management alert experience now consolidates Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list page with expanded user profile details from Microsoft Entra and enhanced note capabilities. This unified view streamlines alert management and investigation for security teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security DLP Integration Preview
updates.summary: In preview: Purview DLP integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforcing restrictive actions based on DLP policies to prevent sensitive data sharing to untrusted cloud apps. This network-layer protection extends DLP coverage to browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms.
